In this milestone, you create an access policy token that safeguards against unauthorized access, ensuring a secure connection between Kubernetes and Grafana Cloud.

The generated token is added to the Helm chart manifest that you run in your Kubernetes cluster.

An access policy token is required for Grafana Alloy to send metrics and logs to Grafana Cloud. You can create a new token, use an existing token, or use a stored Kubernetes Secret. Refer to [Grafana Cloud Access Policies](/docs/grafana-cloud/account-management/authentication-and-permissions/access-policies/) for more information.

To create a new token:

1. Click **Create a new token**.
1. In **Access policy token name**, enter a name.
1. In **Expiration date**, select or enter an expiration, or keep **No expiry**.
1. Click **Create token**.

To use an existing token:

1. Click **Use an existing token**.
1. Paste your token into the box.

To use a stored Kubernetes Secret:

1. Click **Use a stored Kubernetes Secret**.
1. In **Secret name**, enter the existing Secret name.
1. In **Namespace**, keep the installation namespace or enter the Secret namespace.
1. Optionally set **Username key** and **Password key** if your Secret uses non-default keys.
1. Click **Next**.
